note: The book makes a player NAME a Language, a field of Science, a Martial Arts form or an instrument each time they raise one of these Skills, and prints only 'common options' (skills.json descriptions: Geology, Mathematics, Physics, Zoology, Anthropology, Biology, Chemistry, History; Karate, Taekwondo, Judo, Aikido; singing, guitar, drums, violin, piano). These lists are the house rule: common names offered as a pick-list so a typo cannot become a second Skill. They are suggestions, never a limit — engine/specializations.ts always lets the player type another. Language adds no list of its own: it is every language the Cultural Origin tables name, plus Streetslang, which the Role packages grant.
